objects.constraint public.departure_handoff_deli: FOREIGN KEY (recipient_id) REFERENCES departure_handoff_recipients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
objects.constraint public.departure_handoff_offe: CHECK (((close_reason IS NULL) OR ((state = 'closed'::text) AND (close_reason = ANY (ARRAY['withdrawn'::text, 'superseded'::text, 'expired'::text])))))
objects.constraint public.departure_handoff_reci: CHECK (((token_digest IS NULL) OR ((decision IS NULL) AND (token_digest ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text))))
objects.constraint public.departure_handoff_send: FOREIGN KEY (source_booking_id, organization_id) REFERENCES bookings(id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
objects.index public.departure_handoff_deliverie: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX departure_handoff_deliveries_one_queued ON public.departure_handoff_deliveries USING btree (recipient_id) WHERE (state = 'queued'::text)
objects.index public.departure_handoff_offers.de: CREATE INDEX departure_handoff_offers_expiry_idx ON public.departure_handoff_offers USING btree (expires_at, organization_id, source_booking_id, version)
objects.index public.departure_handoff_recipient: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX departure_handoff_recipients_token_digest_key ON public.departure_handoff_recipients USING btree (token_digest) WHERE (token_digest IS NOT NULL)
